<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Hopping Head](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2770)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

A hopping head is shaped like a humanoid head, sometimes with elaborate facial features, other times with a crude toylike visage. Below the head is a spring-loaded column that allows the hopping head to move itself around.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Construct](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4)): DC 15

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 10
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Hopping Head](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2770)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Tiny" />
<trait label="Clockwork" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=331" />
<trait label="Construct" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=35" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Tian Xia World Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=223) pg. 286

**Perception** +8; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Sakvroth](/Languages.aspx?ID=118), [Tien](/Languages.aspx?ID=43)

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +6, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +6

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +1

**Dex** +3

**Con** +0

**Int** -1

**Wis** +2

**Cha** +1
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 14 

**Fort** +5 

**Ref** +10 

**Will** +7 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 25

</row>

**Immunities**
bleed, death effects, disease, doomed, drained, fatigued, healing, nonlethal attacks, paralyzed, poison, sickened, unconscious, vitality, void

**Weaknesses**
electricity 2, orichalcum 2

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
spring +8 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)),
**Damage** 1d6+1 bludgeoning

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
bite +6,
**Damage** 1d8+1 bludgeoning

**Hopping Strike** <actions string="Two Actions" />  The hopping head Leaps 15 feet and makes one spring Strike at any point during that movement, dealing an additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

</column>
